models.name: todo_app_system_setting
models.description:
System-wide configuration settings that govern application behavior and operational constraints.

This table stores all configurable parameters that administrators use to tune system behavior, including authentication timeouts, password policies, rate limits, data retention policies, and performance settings.

System administrators modify these settings to control how the application operates. All system components read these settings to determine behavior. Settings are updated infrequently (typically during deployment or exceptional circumstances), and changes apply system-wide to all users.

Each setting is identified by a unique configuration key and stores its current value along with metadata about the setting type and description for administrative documentation.

plainFields.name: setting_key
plainFields.description: Unique identifier for this configuration setting. Examples: session_timeout_minutes, password_min_length, max_todos_per_user, account_lockout_minutes, failed_login_attempts_limit. Used to retrieve specific settings by name.

plainFields.name: setting_value
plainFields.description: Current value of the setting as a string. Must be parsed to appropriate type (integer, boolean, etc.) by application code. Examples: "30" for session timeout, "10000" for max todos, "true" for email notifications enabled.

plainFields.name: setting_type
plainFields.description: Data type of this setting value. Valid values: "integer", "string", "boolean", "decimal". Indicates how to interpret and validate the setting_value. Guides UI components on how to present the setting for editing.

plainFields.name: setting_category
plainFields.description: Category grouping for related settings. Valid values: "authentication", "password_policy", "data_management", "email_notification", "rate_limiting", "performance". Used for organizing settings in administrative interface.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable description of what this setting controls and its business purpose. Displayed in admin interface to help administrators understand each setting. Example: "Maximum number of minutes a user session remains valid after inactivity."

plainFields.name: default_value
plainFields.description: The default value for this setting as defined during system initialization. Allows admins to reset settings to original defaults. Used when deploying new settings versions.

plainFields.name: min_value
plainFields.description: For numeric settings, the minimum acceptable value. Used for validation when admins attempt to modify settings. Prevents setting invalid values (e.g., negative session timeouts).

plainFields.name: max_value
plainFields.description: For numeric settings, the maximum acceptable value. Used for validation when admins attempt to modify settings. Prevents setting excessive values that could harm system performance.

plainFields.name: is_editable
plainFields.description: Whether this setting can be edited by administrators. True for most settings; false for critical settings that should not be modified after system initialization (e.g., fundamental system identifiers). Determines whether setting appears as editable in admin interface.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this setting was first created, in ISO 8601 format, UTC timezone. Represents when the setting was first added to the system configuration.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this setting's value. Updates each time an administrator changes the setting_value. Used to track when settings were last modified.

models.name: todo_app_user
models.description: Regular user accounts for personal todo management. Stores authentication credentials, profile information, and account metadata for users who can create and manage their own todo items. Each user maintains a completely private, isolated todo list that no other user can access.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's email address used for authentication and account recovery. Must be in valid email format and unique across all user accounts. This is the primary login identifier.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Encrypted password hash using bcrypt with salt rounds >= 12. Passwords are never stored in plain text. The hash includes the salt and algorithm metadata.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: User account creation timestamp in UTC. This value is immutable and records when the user first registered.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp. Updated whenever user profile information or password is changed. Enables tracking of account activity.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. If null, the account is active. If set, the account is marked for deletion but data is retained for compliance and potential recovery within retention period.

plainFields.name: last_active_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the user's most recent activity (login or API request). Updated with each authenticated request. Used to identify inactive accounts for monitoring and engagement analysis.

models.name: todo_app_user_session
models.description: Authentication sessions for regular users. Records active login sessions with connection metadata and timing information. Each session represents an authenticated connection from a specific device or browser, enabling multi-device login support and session management.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key referencing the user who owns this session. Links this authentication session to a specific user account. {@link todo_app_user.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address where the session was initiated. Used for security monitoring and detecting suspicious login patterns from unusual locations.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL (referrer or entry point URL). Records what page or endpoint was accessed when the session was established. Useful for understanding user entry patterns.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP Referrer header or source that led to the connection. May indicate if user came from bookmark, search, external link, or direct access.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp when user successfully authenticated. Recorded in UTC. Used to calculate session age and enforce timeout policies.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration or logout timestamp. If null, the session is still active. If set, indicates when the session ended (either by user logout or automatic expiration).

models.name: todo_app_admin
models.description: Administrator accounts with elevated system-wide permissions. Separate from regular users to maintain clear permission boundaries. Admins can manage user accounts, view system statistics, access audit logs, and configure system settings. Admin data follows same security practices as user accounts.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Admin's email address used for authentication and system notifications. Must be in valid email format and unique across all admin accounts. This is the primary login identifier for admin panel access.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Encrypted password hash using bcrypt with salt rounds >= 12. Passwords are never stored in plain text. The hash includes the salt and algorithm metadata.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Admin account creation timestamp in UTC. This value is immutable and records when the admin account was first created by system operator.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp. Updated whenever admin profile information or password is changed. Enables tracking of account modifications.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. If null, the account is active. If set, the admin account is marked for deletion but data is retained for audit trail and compliance purposes.

plainFields.name: last_active_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the admin's most recent activity (login or API request). Updated with each authenticated request. Used to monitor admin activity and identify inactive admin accounts.

models.name: todo_app_admin_session
models.description: Authentication sessions for administrators. Records active admin login sessions with connection metadata and timing. Each session represents an authenticated admin connection, enabling admin multi-device access and comprehensive session tracking for security auditing.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Foreign key referencing the admin who owns this session. Links this authentication session to a specific admin account. {@link todo_app_admin.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address where the session was initiated. Used for security monitoring, audit trail, and detecting unauthorized admin access attempts from unexpected locations.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL (entry point URL). Records what endpoint was accessed when the admin session was established. Useful for understanding admin panel access patterns.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP Referrer header or source that led to the admin connection. May indicate internal navigation or external access to admin panel.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp when admin successfully authenticated. Recorded in UTC. Used to track when admin panel access occurred and enforce session timeout policies.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration or logout timestamp. If null, the session is still active. If set, indicates when the admin session ended (by logout or automatic expiration after inactivity).

models.name: todo_app_todo
models.description:
Individual todo items representing tasks and action items on a user's personal todo list.

Each todo item is owned by exactly one user and contains all information needed to track a personal task including its description, completion status, and temporal tracking. Todo items are the core business entities that deliver value to users by enabling personal task management.

Users can create multiple todos, view their complete list, edit todo details (title and description), mark todos as complete or incomplete to track progress, and delete todos when no longer needed. Each todo maintains an immutable creation timestamp, tracks the most recent modification time, and records when the user marked it as completed.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: The user who owns this todo item. Every todo belongs to exactly one user. User's {@link todo_app_user.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: The main task description or title of the todo item. Required for every todo item. Minimum 1 character, maximum 255 characters. The primary information users see when viewing their todo list.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional additional details or context about the todo item. Provides space for expanded task information beyond the title. Maximum 2000 characters. Can be empty or null if no additional details are provided.

plainFields.name: is_completed
plainFields.description: Whether this todo item has been marked as complete. True indicates the task is marked finished, false indicates the task is still incomplete. Defaults to false when todo is created.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The date and time when this todo item was created. Set automatically by the system and never changes. Used for chronological ordering and establishing when the task was first captured.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: The date and time when this todo item was last modified. Updates whenever the todo's title, description, or completion status changes. Tracks the most recent change to the todo.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: The date and time when the user marked this todo as completed. Only set when is_completed is true. Cleared (set to null) if user marks a completed todo as incomplete again. Null if todo has never been marked complete.

models.name: todo_app_audit_log
models.description:
Immutable audit trail recording all significant system events for security, compliance, and troubleshooting purposes.

Captures comprehensive records of authentication events (login, logout, password changes), user account operations (registration, deletion), todo item management (create, update, complete, delete), admin actions (user management, settings changes), and security incidents (failed authentication, unauthorized access attempts).

Each audit log entry records exactly what happened, who performed the action, when it occurred, where it originated from (IP address), the outcome, and any relevant error information. Audit logs are immutable - once created, they cannot be modified or deleted during their retention period, ensuring the integrity of the audit trail.

These records serve as the definitive source of truth for system activity and enable administrators to investigate security incidents, trace data modifications, verify compliance with policies, and troubleshoot system issues.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: ID of the user who performed the action. Foreign key referencing {@link todo_app_user.id}. Null for system-level events or unauthenticated operations.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_todo_id
foreignFields.description: ID of the todo item affected by the action (if applicable). Foreign key referencing {@link todo_app_todo.id}. Null for non-todo-related events.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: The specific type of action performed. Examples: 'user_registration', 'user_login', 'user_logout', 'password_change', 'password_reset', 'todo_created', 'todo_updated', 'todo_deleted', 'todo_marked_complete', 'todo_marked_incomplete', 'user_account_status_changed', 'user_account_deleted', 'admin_password_reset', 'unauthorized_access_attempt'.

plainFields.name: resource_type
plainFields.description: The type of resource affected by the action. Examples: 'user', 'todo', 'authentication', 'system_config', 'account', 'session'.

plainFields.name: resource_id
plainFields.description: The unique identifier of the specific resource affected. For todo-related events, this is the todo ID. For user-related events, this is the user ID. For other events, this identifies the specific resource.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: The type of actor who performed the action. Values: 'user' (regular user), 'admin' (administrator), 'system' (automated system action).

plainFields.name: old_value
plainFields.description: For update operations, the previous value before the change. Stored as JSON string for complex objects. Null for create or delete operations.

plainFields.name: new_value
plainFields.description: For create or update operations, the new value after the change. Stored as JSON string for complex objects. Null for delete operations.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: The result of the action. Values: 'success' (action completed successfully), 'failure' (action failed), 'partial' (action partially completed).

plainFields.name: error_message
plainFields.description: If the action failed, description of the error that occurred. Null if status is 'success'. Should not contain sensitive information like passwords or tokens.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: The IP address from which the action was initiated. Used for security analysis and identifying patterns of suspicious activity.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: Browser and client information from the request User-Agent header. Helps identify the type of client application making the request.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Additional contextual information about the action. Examples: bulk operation details, number of items affected, reason for admin action. Stored as JSON for complex data.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: The exact timestamp when the audit log entry was created, recorded in UTC. This timestamp is set automatically and represents the precise moment the event occurred.

models.name: todo_app_alert
models.description:
System alerts tracking anomalies, threshold violations, and conditions requiring administrator attention.

Monitors system health and detects suspicious patterns such as high failure rates, unusual access patterns, resource utilization thresholds, and security-related anomalies. Each alert record documents the condition detected, its severity level, when it was triggered, and the underlying metrics or audit entries that prompted the alert.

Alerts are derived from audit logs and system monitoring and serve to notify administrators of issues requiring investigation or intervention. Alert records are retained for historical trend analysis and incident investigation, allowing administrators to correlate multiple alerts to identify systemic issues or attack patterns.

Alerts support severity levels (info, warning, critical) to help administrators prioritize investigation and response efforts. The alert system enables proactive system management by detecting problems early before they impact users.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_audit_log_id
foreignFields.description: Optional reference to the audit log entry that triggered this alert. Foreign key referencing {@link todo_app_audit_log.id}. Null for alerts generated from system metrics rather than specific events.

plainFields.name: alert_type
plainFields.description: The category or classification of the alert. Examples: 'high_failed_logins', 'rate_limit_exceeded', 'bulk_user_deletion', 'high_api_error_rate', 'unusual_data_access', 'system_performance_degradation', 'concurrent_login_anomaly', 'brute_force_attempt_detected'.

plainFields.name: severity
plainFields.description: The severity level indicating how serious the alert is. Values: 'info' (informational), 'warning' (requires attention), 'critical' (immediate action required).

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Short descriptive title of the alert. Examples: 'High failed login rate detected', 'API error rate above threshold', 'Unusual bulk deletion activity'.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the alert condition, including specific metrics, thresholds, and context. Examples: 'Failed login attempts: 25 from 5 different IPs in 30 minutes', 'Error rate: 12% (threshold: 5%)'.

plainFields.name: metric_name
plainFields.description: The specific metric or condition that triggered the alert. Examples: 'failed_login_count', 'api_error_rate', 'cpu_utilization', 'db_connection_pool_usage'.

plainFields.name: metric_value
plainFields.description: The actual value of the metric that exceeded the threshold. Stored as string to accommodate various data types. Examples: '25', '12%', '85'.

plainFields.name: threshold_value
plainFields.description: The threshold value that was exceeded, triggering the alert. Stored as string for flexibility. Examples: '10', '5%', '80'.

plainFields.name: context_data
plainFields.description: Additional context or metadata related to the alert, stored as JSON. Examples: IP addresses involved, user IDs affected, system component names, resource details.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: The current state of the alert. Values: 'open' (alert still active/unresolved), 'acknowledged' (admin has seen it), 'resolved' (issue has been addressed).

plainFields.name: acknowledged_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when an administrator acknowledged the alert. Null until the alert is acknowledged.

plainFields.name: resolved_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the alert condition was resolved or the alert was closed. Null until the alert is resolved.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the alert was generated, recorded in UTC.
